glossary._note: Fixed terms every French page must use. Brand 'uvaindex.org' and the abbreviations UVA, UVB, UVC, UV, SPF (write 'FPS (SPF)' on first use, then 'FPS'), PA, nm, W/m² stay as they are.
glossary.UVA Index: indice UVA (capitalise as 'Indice UVA' only at the start of a sentence or in titles)
glossary.band names (Low, Moderate, High, Very Hi: Faible, Modéré, Élevé, Très élevé, Extrême
glossary.tone: Use 'vous'. Clear, friendly French for a general audience. Decimal comma in prose (0,5); French typography (no-break space before : ; ? ! and inside « »).
